product: ArcticDEM Mosaic, Version 4.1, 2 m (Polar Geospatial Center, University of Minnesota)
why_not_islandsdem_2m: IslandsDEM v1.0 exists at 2 m but the public download endpoints (ftp.lmi.is / ftp.natt.is, GeoNetwork record e6712430-a63c-4ae5-9158-c89d16da6361, ogc.gis.is WCS) only serve 10/20/50 m GeoTIFFs; the 2 m version is exposed only as WMS/WMTS renders and Cesium mesh tiles. Per the agreed preference order the ArcticDEM v4.1 2 m mosaic is used as primary; an IslandsDEM v1.0 10 m crop of the same box is saved alongside as islandsdem10m_site.tif.
crs: EPSG:3413 (WGS84 / NSIDC Sea Ice Polar Stereographic North)
extent: 3.4 x 3.4 km centred on the site (1700 x 1700 px)
vertical_datum: WGS84 ellipsoid (ellipsoidal heights, metres). NOT geoid. Constant offset vs Icelandic orthometric heights at this site: ArcticDEM - IslandsDEM = +65.98 m (std 0.238 m over the crop), i.e. local geoid undulation.
stated_vertical_accuracy: PGC states no single accuracy number for the v4.1 mosaic; tiles are 'independently vertically adjusted to the Copernicus DEM' (pgc.umn.edu/data/arcticdem). Empirical check here: after removing the constant 65.98 m offset, agreement with IslandsDEM v1.0 (validated Z accuracy better than 0.5 m per LMI record) has std 0.238 m over the 3.4 km crop and residual tilt <0.2 m/km.
acquisition_epoch: Mosaic aggregates 2007-2024 WorldView/GeoEye stereo; at the site pixel, mindate/maxdate rasters give 2013-03-15 to 2020-10-18.
licence: Free and open. Cite: Porter, Claire, et al., 2023, 'ArcticDEM, Version 4.1', https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/3VDC4W, Harvard Dataverse, V1. Use requires acknowledgement per PGC Acknowledgement Policy (DEMs created from DigitalGlobe/Maxar imagery, funded by NSF).

secondary_product.product: IslandsDEM v1.0, 10 x 10 m, ISN93, z = metres above sea level (Landmaelingar Islands / Natturufraedistofnun)
secondary_product.vertical_datum: Orthometric, metres above sea level (Icelandic national height system)
secondary_product.stated_vertical_accuracy: Positional accuracy better than 2 m (XY) and better than 0.5 m (Z), validated against Svarmi drone lidar at 5 sites (GeoNetwork record e6712430-a63c-4ae5-9158-c89d16da6361, gatt.lmi.is)
secondary_product.acquisition_epoch: Built from ArcticDEM/WorldView stereo strips (~2010-2020) plus airborne lidar; file dated 2021-08-30 on the FTP server
secondary_product.caveat: IslandsDEM is itself largely derived from ArcticDEM strips, so the two rasters are not independent of each other; both are independent of the drone photogrammetry.
